name: pacil-read
author: Metahumanz
description: A modern desktop reader application built with Electron and Vue

scripts.build: rimraf release dist dist-electron && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.clean: taskkill /F /IM PacilRead.exe /T /FI "STATUS eq RUNNING" 2>NUL & rimraf release dist dist-electron
scripts.electron:build: npm run clean && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run clean && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run clean && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux
